subtitle: Faster by default
- Faster start
- Cleaner offline
- Timetable week view
- AI chat, upgraded
---
**This update is about speed.** Edupage2 now opens straight into its cached content instead of holding you at a loading screen, and the rest of the app follows the same idea: keep what you have seen, refresh behind it, and never block on the network.

### A faster start
- **No loading screen for signed-in users:** the app opens on your cached overview and restores the session behind it.
- **Less work before the first frame:** session checks, cache warm-up and the settings graph no longer run on the way to the first screen.
- **A generated Baseline Profile:** the startup path is compiled ahead of time on install.

### Cleaner offline
- Timetable, grades, messages and meals stay cached, with skeleton placeholders instead of "failed to load" flashes.

### Timetable and messages
- **Week view:** the whole week fits on one screen without scrolling.
- **AI chat, upgraded:** subject-tagged conversations, streamed replies and one-tap quizzes.
